info.description: Search engine and social sharing metadata. Every field is optional - anything left blank falls back to the page content.

metaTitle.description: Browser tab and search result title. Aim for 50-60 characters.

metaDescription.description: Search result snippet. Aim for 140-160 characters.

ogTitle.description: Title shown when shared on Facebook, WhatsApp, LinkedIn. Defaults to the meta title.

ogDescription.description: Description shown when shared on social media. Defaults to the meta description.

ogImage.description: Share preview image. Use 1200 x 630 pixels for best results.

canonicalUrl.description: Only set this when the page duplicates content that lives at another URL.

noIndex.description: Hide this page from Google and other search engines.
